name: Family cookbook
pitch: Create a family cookbook template with story prompts and photo placeholders.
instructions: in markdown, create a new file named family cookbook.md. write a title header: "# Family Cookbook". add a section "## Recipe templates" with three blank recipe cards. each card has fields for: recipe name, ingredients list, cooking steps, prep time, cook time, and serves. below each card, add a story prompt: "share the story behind this recipe". add a photo placeholder: "[photo: recipe name]" on the line below the story prompt. repeat for three recipes. save the file. read the file back and show it to the person.

examples.does: create a new file named family cookbook.md with a title and three blank recipe cards, each with story prompts and photo placeholders, then show the file content

readme:
# family cookbook
creates a markdown template for a family cookbook with recipe cards, story prompts, and photo placeholders.
needs: make_page, file_write, file_read.
will not: add real recipes or photos.
